sourceText: User approved starting the M0 milestone for the Proof-or-Stop agent prompt consolidation plan, in serial milestone order, to freeze the current 16-prompt baseline before prompt-body edits.
normalizedOutcome: M0 is complete when the repo has a deterministic prompt baseline lockfile, overlap matrix, and verifier command for the current 16 prompts without editing prompt bodies or implementing later role-renaming milestones.
acceptanceClaim: node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs prints PASS with roleCount=16, registry hashes verified, agent_prompt output hashes verified, overlap matrix verified, legacy vocabulary findings classified, and direct story-file findings classified.
